intent: Charters page: explicit type sizes; type test no longer opens a removed disclosure
notes: The 2.37.0 source CI failed on both platforms in the Paper type test for the
Charters page. The test still clicked the "Show all" disclosure that the
Cumberland restyle (0d0b8fe) removed, so it timed out. With that fixed, the
test found a real problem from the same restyle: the section titles and the
commit-coverage caption used rem sizes, so they took their size from the
page root. They now use Paper tokens (`calc(var(--text-section) * 1.2)`,
which keeps 21.6px, and `--text-nav`), with explicit line heights.
The Dashboard Shell charter now lists all 13 surfaces the type test checks.
